positive_snippets: Clean and hygienic. Well maintained rooms. Staffa are very cooperative and well mannered.
negative_snippets:
I booked 3 rooms for 3 nights.. all over experience was very bad .
They are totally unprofessional they don’t have water bottles .
No soap & towels in rooms .
Rooms are very dirty and in bad condition.

After asking many time they provide us towel with was totally wet dirty and teared.

Booked this hotel through OYO, but after reaching the property the management clearly stated that they had stopped accepting OYO bookings over a year ago. This was never mentioned on the platform and caused a lot of inconvenience.

Since I urgently needed a room, I had no choice but to book offline directly at the hotel. The price quoted was 2k, whereas on OYO the same room was shown for around Rs.900+. When I asked if I could book online with he registered platform, the manager refused, which made it evident that the intention was to charge a higher amount offline.

Additionally, OYO has not processed my refund even after the cancellation.

My advice:

Please do not book here without checking live photos or videos of the rooms.

Avoid relying on OYO for family or business trips, as there is no proper accountability or support.
